scope: BgEffects implementation, arithmetic subset and BG-effect identifier lists only. No launcher, game assets, ROM bytes or player state copied.
modifications: BgEffects arithmetic dependency uses Gen2AnimMath instead of the full reference object pool.
A missing jump-table list resolves through edition-specific Gen2BgEffectIds for older native caches.
Existing Gen2AnimPlayer dispatches BG/palette commands and steps the pool from its current VM update; its legacy visual adapter resolves edition-specific IDs by names.
